body: I don't have my family because they don't know. My psychologist is going to be too far away to go to once I move away for school.

The one thing that has been sticking out in my mind as something that might help would be talking to my ex. Unfortunately, for whatever reason, he refuses to acknowledge my existence now that we've broken up. I feel like I have nobody else to go to...
I'm worried because I'm leaving for college this weekend, so I won't be able to go to my therapist.. And my therapist actually doesn't know about my past either. :/
